name: 32726 · Eustis, FL
findings: ZIP 32726 (Eustis) has 81 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32726 (Eustis) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32726 (Eustis) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 31% of the typical level).
